title: [GMCP 203.019.02] Production path: Human consent, approvals, and interaction UX
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-019-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Every consequential MCP action has a consistent inspect-before-run experience showing server identity, exact tool and arguments, data leaving the machine, credentials and side effects, with session and durable consent scoped separately. Approval is revocable, non-transferable and inaccessible to untrusted content; headless denial, accessibility, batching, timeout and emergency-stop behavior are all deterministic and audited. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
